fact: The 2024 civil status statistical yearbook gives an annual birth registration rate of 57.6% and 55.4% within the legal delay for 2024, and carries Cityweb birth and death declaration counts by region for 2024.
title: Annuaire statistique d'état civil 2024
publisher: Ministère de l'Intérieur et de la Sécurité, DESPSE
